name: 分岐を持つ学習の道すじ
prompt:
Create one faithful Lighthouse learning-path component, LH05-0100. Output only the isolated component on pure white. Use the original Mimo screenshot region [44,558,631,846] as PRIMARY evidence for path, icon anatomy, embossed rounded-square proportions and state; secondary mock establishes five-node layout only. Do not reproduce the rest of the phone, header or navigation. Restore source details omitted by the mock. Work at logical 390x470 with proportional high-resolution output. Five rounded-square nodes: (148,8),(268,128),(148,248),(28,368),(148,368), each 92x88 face with 8px lower lip, corner radius about26. First, second and bottom-left have source's solid bold check glyph, NOT thin line checks. Third and bottom-middle have source's compact zigzag lightning bolt, NOT the mock's long pointed abstract glyph. Source's first four purple nodes become forest-gradient #174C36→#1F6444→#2D8F5E faces with white check/bolt; lower lips subtly deeper forest, restrained depth. The bottom-middle gold practice node remains semantic warm pale gold face, gold border/lip and ochre bolt, distinguishable from completed nodes. Restore the quiet, regularly spaced faint neutral dot grid behind nodes. The connecting route must follow the ORIGINAL: from first node's right midpoint go horizontally right then round down to second node center; continue vertically down behind second and curve left to third node's right midpoint; from third node's left midpoint go left then curve down behind bottom-left node and exit a short amount below its bottom. No line connects the gold bottom-middle node. Route pale desaturated forest at about7 logical px, source rounded corners; never add diagonal branches. White outer background; no mint panel. This component has no text. Retain source node positions, spacing, thick checks and source bolt geometry; do not add buttons, numbers, labels or badges. Style reference controls white/forest materials, not layout. Flat front view, crisp editable-looking shapes, gentle depth, no giant shadows or glossy plastic.
CORRECTION: use the previous output for its forest/gold surfaces, exact icon designs and correct route, but enlarge the VERTICAL SPACING. Exact full canvas 390x470 logical units, do not add padding/letterboxing. Top node face starts y8, not y30. Second node y128. Third node y248. Bottom two nodes y368. Faces are92x88, not scaled down. The output currently puts top at y30 and bottom at y346 and squeezes the path; correct top upward22 and bottom downward22 while third downabout0-10. Bottom node lower lip ends y464 with only6px canvas below. Top has only8px white margin. Maintain x148,268,148,28,148. No other changes. Dot grid should remain behind the corrected evenly 120px-spaced rows.
reviewNotes: Correction restores top node near the intended top margin and preserves five nodes, route, checks/bolts and gold practice state. Bottom row remains high and route tail/canvas lower spacing differ from original/native. Static raster only; no owner acceptance or editable/app claim.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
